notes: τοῦ περισσεύοντος αὐτοῖς is analysed with rule 20's possessive-dative arm: αὐτοῖς is free to take *their* and the article realizes nothing, rather than the article supplying a substantival pronoun.
The italicized appositional *even* was folded onto ὅλον; rule 105 settles only the preposition and substantival-article carriers, and neither stands here, so marking it added remains defensible.
